entries.text: Once per encounter, gain advantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, or saving throws until the end of your next turn.

entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

entries.name: Shuriken

entries.name: Seal
